welcome:
Absorbent turns a lecture recording into structured, illustrated notes. Send one audio/video recording or a YouTube link; add PDFs, presentations and photos separately. You receive PDF, HTML, Markdown and ZIP.

Limits: recording up to {max_hours} h and {max_media_gb} GB, materials up to {max_material_mb} MB and {max_pages} pages. Quota: {quota_jobs} runs per {quota_hours} h; administrators bypass the quota only.

Inputs and results remain on the server until an administrator deletes them. Data is sent to your selected cloud models; local models process it on this server. You review parameters and providers before starting.

Free and open-source software (FOSS), GNU GPL v3 or later. Self-host with your own local or cloud models:
https://github.com/ivan-mikhnovich/absorbent
https://github.com/ivan-mikhnovich/absorbobot

Installed core: Absorbent {version}
Commit: {commit}
help:
/new — new lecture: send a recording or YouTube link, then additional materials and press “Files added”. Choose parameters and confirm the summary.
/jobs — history and redelivery; /settings — parameters; /language — language; /cancel — confirm cancellation of your unfinished jobs; /stats — your statistics; /version — versions.

Photos use the largest available size; send as a document to preserve the original. Recordings are never silently concatenated. Deleting a Telegram message does not delete server files. Cancellation does not refund quota or money already spent. Free delivery of an existing result remains available when your quota is exhausted.
dialog.existing_draft: You already have a lecture draft. Replace it with a new lecture? Existing files remain on the server. Active preparation must stop first.
dialog.stopping_draft: Stopping preparation. Once it has stopped, use /new to create a fresh lecture.
dialog.send_source: Draft {id}. Send exactly one recording or a YouTube link. Then add your materials.
dialog.need_new: Use /new to create a lecture draft first.
dialog.preparing: Preparation is in progress. Wait for it to finish or use /cancel.
dialog.second_source: This draft already has one recording. Replace the draft, or finish adding materials. Recordings are never merged implicitly.
dialog.source_first: Send the recording or YouTube link first; add materials afterwards.
dialog.youtube_mode: YouTube preparation: video or audio only? Only a single public, non-live YouTube video is supported.
dialog.add_materials: Input queued for preparation. You may send additional documents or photos, then press Files added. Files must finish importing before confirmation.
dialog.accepted: Job {id} accepted. FIFO position: {position}. A new run consumes quota even if it fails or is cancelled.
dialog.delivery_pending: Result delivery has been queued. Telegram delivery failure will not restart processing.
dialog.cancel_prompt: Cancel this selected set of your unfinished jobs ({count}) and drafts ({drafts})? Quota and already consumed processing resources are not refunded.
dialog.cancel_requested: Cancellation recorded. Running preparation or processing stops and is reaped before another task starts. Completed jobs are not cancelled.
dialog.language: Select the interface language. Notes follow it unless you explicitly override their language.
dialog.number: Enter a finite number for {name}. fps > 0; hash threshold integer 0–64; minimum scene duration ≥ 0; slides DPI positive integer. /settings returns to the menu.
error.quota: Processing quota exhausted. Next slot becomes available at {timestamp} (UTC). Existing-result delivery is still free.
error.model_missing: Selected {category} model “{model}” is no longer available. Choose an available model in Advanced; no replacement was made.
error.invalid_number: Invalid value. Use a finite number within the stated range; integer settings require an integer.
error.draft_incomplete: The recording or some materials have not finished importing. Wait for preparation; then review the summary again.
error.summary_changed: Parameters, files, models or core version changed since this summary. Review and confirm a fresh summary.
error.model_keys_unavailable: The selected model cannot run: required server credentials are unavailable. Contact an administrator or select another model.
error.reuse_unavailable: The existing result is no longer available. Choose a new processing run or cancel; no processing starts automatically.
error.paused: The server is paused. New preparation will resume after an administrator resumes it.
error.execution_busy: Another preparation or job is active. Please wait.
error.stale: This action is no longer available. Reopen /settings or /jobs.
error.unsupported_input: Send one recording or a public HTTPS YouTube link. Arbitrary links, commands and paths are not accepted as processing parameters.
